competency_fulfillment.rationale: The items directly fulfill the competency requirement of comparing different denominations of peso coins and bills up to ₱100. For instance, seed 42 asks "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱20 bill?", seed 44 asks "Which has a smaller value: 1 ₱20 bill or 1 ₱1 coin?", and seed 501 asks "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱10 coin or 1 ₱1 coin?". All items prompt pairwise value comparisons of Philippine peso currency denominations without introducing centavo coins or denominations exceeding ₱100.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The sample set comprehensively covers comparisons across various currency types and directions. It includes bill-to-bill comparisons (e.g., seed 42: "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱20 bill?", seed 604: "Which has a smaller value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱20 bill?"), bill-to-coin comparisons (e.g., seed 45: "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱50 bill or 1 ₱10 coin?", seed 55: "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱5 coin?"), coin-to-bill comparisons (e.g., seed 50: "Which has a smaller value: 1 ₱10 coin or 1 ₱50 bill?", seed 607: "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱10 coin or 1 ₱20 bill?"), and coin-to-coin comparisons (e.g., seed 501: "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱10 coin or 1 ₱1 coin?"). Both "greater value" and "smaller value" comparison directions are balanced across the samples.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The phrasing is concise, clear, and perfectly suited for Grade 1 Quarter 4 learners. Questions such as "Which has a smaller value: 1 ₱20 bill or 1 ₱1 coin?" (seed 44) and "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱50 bill or 1 ₱10 coin?" (seed 45) use straightforward comparative language without unnecessary cognitive load, complex sentence structures, or multi-step operations.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The items showcase diverse structural presentation formats, including multiple choice (mcq, read_mcq), fill-in-the-blank (set_fill_in_blank), and cloze formatters. Diverse pairs of denominations across ₱1, ₱5, ₱10 coins and ₱20, ₱50, ₱100 bills are utilized across both directional queries, as seen in "Which has a greater value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱5 coin?" (seed 55) and "Which has a smaller value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱10 coin?" (seed 502).

competency_alignment.rationale: The items strictly adhere to the learning competency scope. They exclusively compare peso coins (₱1, ₱5, ₱10) and bills (₱20, ₱50, ₱100) up to ₱100 without straying into centavos, multi-denomination summation, or operations beyond the curriculum mandate. Examples like seed 501 ("Which has a greater value: 1 ₱10 coin or 1 ₱1 coin?") and seed 607 ("Which has a greater value: 1 ₱10 coin or 1 ₱20 bill?") demonstrate precise curricular alignment.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All numerical values and denominations tested are well within the curriculum ceiling of ₱100, incorporating standard Philippine currency units (₱1, ₱5, ₱10, ₱20, ₱50, ₱100) as observed in seed 42 ("Which has a greater value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱20 bill?") and seed 46 ("Which has a smaller value: 1 ₱100 bill or 1 ₱1 coin?"). No quantities exceed ₱100.
